description: Offline native cache cleaner that scans and removes rebuildable application caches.
pre_install: $binary = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'outrash-*-windows-amd64.exe' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $binary) { throw 'Outrash executable was not found.' }; Rename-Item -LiteralPath $binary.FullName -NewName 'outrash.exe'
notes: Outrash works offline, has no configuration files or logs, and only lists rebuildable caches for deletion. Review selected paths before confirming.
